glosses: unreserved, unqualified, unconditional

examples.text: безогово́рочная капитуля́ция

glosses: не ограниченный никакими условиями, не предусматривающий никаких оговорок

examples.text: Я честно выполнил условие, моя победа была полной и безоговорочной.

glosses: Not reserved.
Not booked in advance: with no reservation.

examples.text: For the steam services, passengers with reserved seats are assembled behind the appropriate notice boards in the centre cab road, which is barred to motor traffic on summer Saturdays. Unreserved passengers line up behind other boards, which merely display destinations and not departure times.

It cannot be right that someone who joins a train at 0800, having paid perhaps £200 for a single at the ticket office and who sits in an unreserved seat, can be removed from that seat at 1200 by someone who joins en route with a cheap Advance fare that he didn't even buy until 1100, and yet which came with a compulsory reservation. That turns our first passenger's seat from unreserved to reserved midway through the journey and is, to me, commercially immoral.

glosses: simple past and past participle of unreserve
Not qualified: ineligible; unfit for a position or task.

examples.text: His lack of a high school diploma renders him unqualified for the job.
An obvious characteristic of a kakistocrat is inserting unqualified loyalists into positions of power. Nepotism and kakistocracy go hand-in-hand.

glosses: Not elaborated upon; undescribed; unrestricted.

examples.text: The right to free speech is well established as not being an unqualified right to violent incitement nor to free amplification.

Obviously, we must reject the existence of an unqualified or unspecified right to know. If the right to know did not require disclosure of only specific (types of) data or information, a person could be said to have a right to know just anything whatsoever.

[…] there is a multiplicity in the unqualified or unspecified concept of “soul,” such that it still retains its real meaning but by its very definition is predicated of different levels of things, at least in the classical conception of “soul.”

glosses: Outright; thorough; utter; unhampered.

examples.text: an unqualified success
Gibson is an unqualified fool, and only fit to mix with beasts of the same calibre; […]
The silicon rectifiers installed in the 42 English Electric-equipped units of the Shenfield augmentation stock have proved an unqualified success; [...].

glosses: simple past and past participle of unqualify
Absolute; without conditions, limitations, reservations or qualifications.

examples.text: We demand your unconditional surrender.

So that there can be no possible misunderstanding, both Germany and Japan can be certain beyond any shadow of a doubt that America will continue to fight for freedom until no vestige of resistance remains. Our demand has been and it remains unconditional surrender.

glosses: That which is not conditional.

examples.text: The me, the world, and God, are the three unconditionals, the three absolutes […]

glosses: A conditional-like structure expressing that the consequent holds true regardless of the particular value of the antecedent.
Absolute; having no exception.

examples.text: We now see that they [propositions] are either conditional or unconditional, or, as the logicians say, hypothetical (conditional) or categorical (unconditional).

Daytime interests are clearly not such far-reaching psychical sources of dreams as might have been expected from the categorical assertions that everyone continues to carry on his daily business in his dreams.

glosses: Of, pertaining to, or using a category or categories.
A categorical proposition.
Absoluto, sin restricción ni requisito.
privo di condizionamento
senza alcun'altra possibilità ammessa

examples.text: accordo incondizionato

examples.text: Roosevelt w sprawie Niemiec zaproponował formułę, której użył w czasie amerykańskiej wojny domowej generał Ulysses S. Grant — „bezwarunkowa kapitulacja”

glosses: okrutny, pozbawiony współczucia

examples.text: Ten bezwzględny bandzior trząsł całą okolicą.

examples.text: Obowiązuje bezwzględny zakaz kąpieli w jeziorze!
Bezwzględne tlenowce rosną tylko w obecności tlenu atmosferycznego.

examples.text: Datowanie bezwzględne w archeologii nie zależy od datowania przypisanego innym artefaktom.

examples.text: Błąd bezwzględny pomiaru to różnica między wartością zmierzoną i wartością dokładną.

glosses: Qui est sans condition, sans réserve, total.

examples.text: D'un côté, les fanatiques qui gouroutisent Hamer (à moins que Hamer ne se gouroutise lui-même), en même temps qu'ils le victimisent. De l'autre, les détracteurs, tout aussi inconditionnels, qui ne voient dans les théories hamériennes qu'une pseudoscience.
Donner un accord inconditionnel, être un partisan inconditionnel.

glosses: Personne qui adhère totalement, qui est partisan sans réserve, en particulier dans le domaine politique. → voir fan, fervent, godillot

examples.text: Les inconditionnels de la majorité présidentielle, une inconditionnelle des Rolling Stones.
Staline n’était pourtant pas un inconditionnel du léninisme.
